CTC.settings.auto.name: Automatic draw
CTC.settings.auto.hint: Off: the Keeper clicks the button on the roll card when the consequence fits the scene. On: the draw happens by itself on every critical success or fumble.
CTC.settings.visibilite.name: Who sees the consequence
CTC.settings.visibilite.hint: Everyone, or the Keeper only (to prepare or adapt the consequence before narrating it).
CTC.speaker: Consequence
CTC.tablesCreees: {n} consequence tables created in the “Critiques et maladresses” folder.
CTC.err.tables: Could not create the consequence tables (see the F12 console).
CTC.settings.test.name: Test without rolling
CTC.settings.test.label: Open the test window
CTC.settings.test.hint: Pick a skill and a result type: the consequence card appears in the chat (and the Critiques du Mythe full-screen effect if that module is active), without rolling a single die.
CTC.test.effet: Also the full-screen effect (Critiques du Mythe)
